data.title: bn-we9x: validate + instrument the sealed-directory chooser
data.description: Chooser rule was Spike H's lookup crossover (n>=8 && U<=8n); bn-dcr showed the codec is serialization-only, so the criterion was wrong. Replaced with design.md 12.6's byte-cost comparison (emit the smaller image, sorted on tie => U <= 64*(n-3)). Validated on all 39 real engine-written segment directories: 8 were 6-14% over optimal, 48,880 B total; new rule is optimal on 39/39. Measured decode cost of the extra bitrank region (ABBA-paired, load1 3.8): 273.2 -> 277.0 us across the whole corpus. Four new property tests pin byte-optimality, exactness of BOTH codecs on every shape, a single monotone flip at the break-even (no oscillation), and byte-identical re-encode at section + whole-pack scale. Instrumentation: SealedSegmentIndex::dir_codec(), dir_codec_of(path) (header+directory+trailer only), and 'dir_codec' in mess inspect's per-segment row. mess-index+mess-store 424/424; workspace check + fmt clean; floors 14/14 PASS.
